provenance: Existing database events; human-versus-test origin is not independently verified. No synthetic engagement is added by this exporter.

cases: signed recommendations record real positions/source and deduplicate impressions, clicks and retries
clients cannot forge package, position, signature, owner, session or expired recommendation receipts
recommendation attribution checks same account/session/package, branch and 24 hour click window
metrics distinguish held checkouts from successful bookings and preserve zero-data null rates
aggregate metrics require chain management roles and an active role guard
PostgreSQL measurement joins count conversions once, exclude HOLD/CANCELLED and see paid invoices
recommendation impressions count only visible cards and clicks carry the signed backend receipt
refreshing profile recommendations reloads the merged list and preserves behavior cards
selecting a package records a view but never fabricates an abandoned checkout
payment result reads confirmed status from DB without contacting PayOS
pending result reads DB and makes only one delayed PayOS sync instead of continuous polling
refund states stop polling, hide payment retry and never issue a check-in pass
package booking links use the actual method and incomplete data opens its detail
quotes use package prices for specialty/after-hours/packages and doctor fees for doctor/online flows
specialty checkout sends the selected service and doctor slot, then uses the server invoice total for PayOS
followup enables doctor-slot booking and passes the wizard first step without selecting a package
family checkout preserves the service and selected real slot and uses server total
missing PayOS URL reports an error without marking the family payment successful
family PayOS retry reuses the held order and server total without creating a second checkout
time conflicts allow adjacent or separate visits and catch partial overlaps
single PayOS retry and double click reuse the existing booking and its server amount
payment simulation still requires the explicit demo action
recommendation click survives detail views and supplies the backend-validated source to checkout
failed telemetry remains queued and retries with the same event ID before booking
a newer search click wins over an older recommendation for the same package
existing analytics storage upgrades safely and expired sources never produce a conversion
